attractions.name: Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park
attractions.description: Mausoleum and museum dedicated to Ghana's first president, Kwame Nkrumah

attractions.name: Cape Coast Castle
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage site; former slave trading post with museum

attractions.name: Kakum National Park Canopy Walkway
attractions.description: 350m long suspension bridge walkway 40m above the rainforest floor
tips: Avoid if you have severe vertigo

attractions.name: Mole National Park
attractions.description: Ghana's largest wildlife reserve with elephants, antelopes, and 300+ bird species

attractions.name: Labadi Beach
attractions.description: Popular public beach with music, food stalls, horse rides, and beach sports

attractions.name: Manhyia Palace Museum
attractions.description: Official residence of the Asantehene; museum of Ashanti history and the Golden Stool

attractions.name: Elmina Castle (St. George's Castle)
attractions.description: Oldest European building in sub-Saharan Africa; UNESCO World Heritage site

attractions.name: Aburi Botanical Gardens
attractions.description: Beautiful hilltop botanical garden from 1890 with cool climate and scenic views
tips: 30 min drive from Accra via winding road

attractions.name: Wli Waterfalls
attractions.description: Tallest waterfall in West Africa at 80m, set in the Agumatsa Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.best_time: After rainy season (September–November) for strongest flow
tips: Hire a guide at the entrance
Bring swimwear for the plunge pool

attractions.name: Independence Square (Black Star Square)
attractions.description: Historic square with Independence Arch, Black Star Gate, and eternal flame
tips: Combine with Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park (5 min walk)

attractions.name: Lake Volta Cruise
attractions.description: Cruise on the world's largest man-made lake by surface area

attractions.name: Kwesi Plange Arts Centre
attractions.description: Open-air market for Ghanaian arts, crafts, textiles, and souvenirs
tips: Bargain — start at 50% of quoted price
